lines.en:
Cultist scum...  you must have a death wish, coming here.
Did you see that?!
Black dragon above!!!
Your time has come to an end.

lines.zh: 你、你是谁…… 你是什么？

lines.en: Have you not foreseen this in your precious texts?  Your Temple has kept the truth locked away for far too long.  Now, you will know justice.
lines.zh: 你没有在你们那宝贝典籍中预见到这一幕吗？ 你们的圣殿将真相封锁太久了。 现在，你将明白什么是正义。
圣、圣骑士们…… 打败他们！!
